name: edge-daily-best
description: A player who comes back once a day and plays the best reference program found for each map. Skraj lasu, the first map, is tried by hand until it is solved; its earning loop then runs until the last map of the list is solved. The player cashes the loop in when its points would buy a rank of the list, or when the next map is due. The next map is tried only while the team's resurrection has a use left: Las with nothing taken from the chest, Las — głębiej with eight sticks and seven berries.
